subject: Redwood discovery — next steps & pricing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood discovery — next steps & pricing

Jordan — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

- Key takeaways: Acme wants predictable latency for customer-facing chat, isolation for PII workloads, and to reduce per-token costs for high-volume nightly batch jobs.
- Proposed initial scope: Hosted API for prototypes + Dedicated pool for production PII workloads.
- Pricing ballpark: attached a two-pager with committed capacity pricing and a sample usage model (redwood-pricing.pdf).
- Actions: 1) Can you confirm the expected monthly token volume for the two workloads? 2) Security checklist: do you need SOC 2 evidence or an on-prem option for the PII flow?

I've attached our discovery notes and a short pricing summary. If it helps, we can schedule a short follow-up with David (sec/compliance) to walk your security team through SOC 2 scope.

Next step: Are you available next Tue/Wed afternoon PT for a 30-min pricing + security follow-up? If not, tell me what timing works and I'll send invites.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-pricing.pdf, redwood-discovery-notes.docx

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Pat Smith <pat.smith@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood discovery — next steps & pricing

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap. I shared the notes with Pat (infra) and we should be able to get ballpark monthly token counts by early next week. For SOC 2, we will need the report summary — can you send the SOC 2 scope and an evidence summary for our security team?

Also, for the Dedicated option, are there minimum commit terms we should be aware of?

—Jordan
Jordan Lee
Director, Platform Engineering | Acme Enterprises
jordan.lee@acme.com | (617) 555-0456

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood discovery — next steps & pricing

Jordan — checking in quickly on the token estimates and SOC 2 request. I've attached a one-page SOC 2 summary (SOC2-Summary.pdf) that highlights scope and controls — should help your security team triage.

Regarding Dedicated commits: we have flexible terms (monthly rolling or 12/24-month reserved tiers). The pricing doc includes an example commit for predictable throughput — happy to walk through options on a call.

Would you or Pat have 20–30 minutes next Tue (6/2) to review? If that doesn't work, tell me a window that does and I'll coordinate.

Thanks —
Marissa

Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood discovery — next steps & pricing

Jordan / Pat — wanted to add a quick note with a couple of datapoints that might help decisioning: 

- Typical latency for our Hosted API for similar workloads: 60–120ms median for 8k-token context with continuous batching.
- For Dedicated PII workloads, customers commonly start with a 3–6 month reserved pool to stabilize costs and then move to monthly rolling after capacity patterns are stable.

I also attached a sample usage model (same pricing doc) showing how a hybrid Hosted + Dedicated setup can reduce unit costs by ~30% once batch jobs are routed to the dedicated pool.

If you need a short technical runthrough for Pat, David and I can do a 30-min deep dive next week. No pressure — just want to make it easy to evaluate.

Best,
Marissa

Jordan — wanted to close the loop on this thread. I haven't heard back after my last couple of notes, so checking whether the timing/priority has changed on your side. If Acme is still evaluating and you'd like me to keep this open, I'm happy to wait — or we can pick this back up when it becomes higher priority.

If I don't hear back by EOD next Tues (6/23), I'll close the file on our side to keep our pipeline accurate. If you'd prefer someone else on your team to handle the follow-up, please let me know who and I'll connect them to Aditya (solution engineering) and David (security).

Thanks for your time — really enjoyed meeting you and learning about Acme's roadmap.

Cheers,
